title: Startup Cell & Incubation | KPGU
content: Hackathon 2023 Innovators tackled problem statements from ministries and industries. 20-10-2023 to 21-10-2023 Participation of KPGU Startups in TiECON, Vadodara Student entrepreneurs actively participated in TiECON Vadodara. 20-10-2023 GENESIS Awareness Event by MeitY Workshop on Gen-Next Support for Innovative Startups Scheme (GENESIS). 16-01-2023 National Startup Day Celebration Session on "Innovation to Startup Journey" by Shri Bharat Bafna.
